consultation.hours: 10:00 to 17:00 Amman time (GMT+3); slots start on the hour from 10:00 to 16:00
rules: A slot must be at least 2 hours from now
The booking is confirmed when the visitor sends the WhatsApp confirmation message
consultation.booking_flow: Collect day, time and method first (any order, from one message if the visitor gives them all), confirm them back warmly, then ask for the name, then the phone number, then book.
